name: UltaHost
summary: Budget-friendly web hosting across shared, VPS, WordPress and dedicated plans — NVMe SSD storage, free SSL and migration, DDoS protection and 24/7 multilingual support, from 30+ global data centers.
best_for: budget-conscious owners, developers and small businesses that want cheap, fast NVMe hosting (shared or VPS) with free migration and DDoS protection, and will prepay a multi-year term
skip_if: you run a business-critical, high-traffic site that needs premium managed hosting with guaranteed enterprise support, or you don't want to lock into a multi-year term to get the good rate
honest_knock: It's the classic budget-host trade-off, with one thing in its favour. The sticker price is a term commitment: the page opens on the 2-year prices, and the 30/40/50% badges are measured from a crossed-out list price rather than from what monthly billing actually costs, so the real saving for prepaying two years is about 22% on Starter. What works in its favour is the renewal: each card states it renews at the same rate for the same term, so the usual cheap-first-term-then-dear-second trap is at least written down. Read that line on the plan you actually pick. Support is generally fast but can be hit-or-miss depending on which agent picks up your ticket, and it's a smaller, less-established brand than the big managed hosts. It's a value play, not a premium-SLA one.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month (list $6.89) on the 2-year term, 1 domain, ~10,000 visits/mo
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-01 on ultahost.com/shared-hosting, all four term tabs rendered) The term ladder is Monthly, Yearly -30%, 2 Years -40% and 3 Years -50%, and the page opens on the two-year term. At that term the shared plans are Starter $3.44/mo (list $6.89) for 1 domain, ~10,000 visits a month and 30 GB NVMe; Basic $5.18 (list $9.19) for 4 domains, ~15,000 visits and 60 GB; Business $10.35 (list $17.02) for unlimited domains, ~25,000 visits and 80 GB; and Pro $13.23 (list $21.62) for ~49,000 visits and 110 GB. Monthly billing is $4.39, $6.39, $12.29 and $16.29 (badged 'Save 25%'); one year $4.03, $6.33, $12.08 and $14.94; three years $2.88, $4.37, $8.63 and $10.93. Every card states it renews at its own rate for the same term ('Renews at $3.44/mo for 2 years. Cancel anytime.'). The banner now reads 'Starting at $3.44/mo', matching the card; on 9 September it read $4.13. 30-day money-back guarantee, free SSL, free backups, cPanel.
